indicator.subject: Science
indicator.content_standard: B6.5.2.1 Demonstrate knowledge of common diseases of humans; causes, symptoms, effects and prevention
indicator.objective: Explain the causes, symptoms and prevention of Eczema

skills.description: Identify causes/triggers of eczema (e.g. dry skin, irritants, allergies).
Identify common symptoms of eczema (e.g. itchy skin, redness, rash).
Identify ways to prevent or manage eczema (e.g. moisturising, avoiding irritants, keeping skin clean).
State effects of eczema on a person (e.g. discomfort, itching, skin damage).
State what to do if someone shows signs of eczema (see a health worker).
Organise causes, symptoms and prevention of eczema in a simple table or map.

spec.difficultyPlan: 20 questions total — Difficulty 1: 5; Difficulty 2: 7; Difficulty 3: 5; Difficulty 4: 3.
misconceptions: Eczema is caused by dirty water only.
Eczema is the same as measles.

questions.stem: Which of these can cause eczema?
questions.explanation: Eczema can be caused by dry skin and contact with irritants such as soap or dust.
questions.misconception: Eczema is caused by dirty water only.

questions.stem: Which of these is a common symptom of eczema?
hints: Eczema makes the skin feel uncomfortable.
It often makes you want to scratch.
questions.explanation: Itchy skin is a common symptom of eczema.

questions.stem: Which of these helps prevent eczema?
questions.explanation: Moisturising the skin regularly helps prevent eczema by keeping the skin from drying out.

questions.stem: How can eczema affect a person?
questions.explanation: Eczema causes discomfort and itching, which can affect a person's daily life.

questions.stem: What should you do if you think someone has eczema?
options: Tell an adult and see a health worker
questions.explanation: If someone shows signs of eczema, tell an adult and see a health worker for advice.
questions.misconception: Eczema does not need medical attention.

questions.stem: Ama says, 'Eczema is caused by dirty water.' What is the best correction?
options: Yes, eczema comes from dirty water
No, eczema can be caused by dry skin and irritants
No, eczema is caused by too much sun
No, eczema is caused by eating too much
hints: Irritants like soap can trigger it.
questions.explanation: Eczema is not caused by dirty water. It can be caused by dry skin, irritants and allergies.
questions.misconception: Eczema is caused by dirty water only.

questions.stem: Which set lists common symptoms of eczema?
questions.explanation: Common symptoms of eczema include itchy skin, redness and a rash.

questions.stem: Which of these can help manage eczema?
options: Avoiding harsh soaps and using mild moisturisers
Using very hot water on the skin
hints: Harsh soaps can irritate the skin.
questions.explanation: Avoiding harsh soaps and using mild moisturisers can help manage eczema.

questions.stem: Why can eczema be uncomfortable for a person?
options: It causes constant itching and redness
questions.explanation: Eczema causes constant itching and redness, which can be very uncomfortable.

questions.stem: A learner has red, itchy skin that might be eczema. What should the learner do?
options: Tell the teacher and visit a health worker
Scratch the skin until it bleeds
questions.explanation: The learner should tell the teacher and visit a health worker for proper advice and treatment.

questions.stem: Give one cause of eczema.
hints: Think about what can irritate the skin.
questions.explanation: Causes of eczema include dry skin, irritants like soap or dust, and allergies.

questions.stem: Name two symptoms of eczema.
questions.explanation: Common symptoms of eczema include itchy skin, redness and a rash.

questions.stem: Give one way to prevent or manage eczema.
hints: Keep the skin from drying out.
questions.explanation: Ways to prevent or manage eczema include moisturising the skin regularly and avoiding harsh soaps or irritants.

questions.stem: Draw a simple table with three columns: 'Causes', 'Symptoms' and 'Prevention'. Write one correct point under each column for eczema.

criteria.description: Wrote one correct cause of eczema
Wrote one correct symptom of eczema
Wrote one correct way to prevent eczema
Organised the points clearly under the three headings

hints: Think about dry skin for causes.
questions.explanation: This is a written task. Your teacher will mark it using the rubric.
questions.misconception: Eczema has no clear causes or prevention.

questions.stem: Why is eczema sometimes confused with other skin rashes?
options: Because it causes redness and itching like other rashes
Because it causes a broken leg
hints: Redness and itching can look like other rashes.
questions.explanation: Eczema can be confused with other skin rashes because it causes redness and itching, which are common to many skin conditions.
questions.misconception: Eczema is the only skin rash.

questions.stem: A pupil with eczema is advised to avoid harsh soaps. Why?
options: Harsh soaps can dry and irritate the skin
Harsh soaps make the skin soft
Harsh soaps make the skin lighter
questions.explanation: Harsh soaps can dry and irritate the skin, making eczema worse.

questions.stem: Explain how eczema can affect a person's daily life.
answer: it causes constant itching and discomfort which can disturb sleep and activities
the itching can make it hard to concentrate or sleep
it can make a person uncomfortable and self-conscious
questions.explanation: Eczema can cause constant itching and discomfort, which may disturb sleep, make it hard to concentrate and affect a person's confidence.
questions.misconception: Eczema has no effect on daily life.

questions.stem: What should you do if a classmate has itchy, red skin that might be eczema?
answer: tell the teacher and encourage them to see a health worker
advise them to see a health worker and inform an adult
tell an adult and get medical help
questions.explanation: You should tell the teacher and encourage your classmate to see a health worker for advice.
questions.misconception: Eczema does not need medical attention.

questions.stem: Design a simple poster for your class about eczema. Show one cause, one symptom and one way to prevent it. Use drawings and short words.

criteria.description: Showed one correct cause of eczema
Showed one correct symptom of eczema
Showed one correct way to prevent eczema
Used clear drawings and short words
Poster is neat and suitable for learners

hints: Think about dry skin for a cause.
Draw itchy skin for a symptom.
questions.explanation: This is a drawing task. Your teacher will mark it using the rubric.

questions.stem: Write a short message (3–4 sentences) for your school notice board about eczema. Include what causes it, one symptom, and one way to prevent it.

criteria.description: Stated one correct cause of eczema
Stated one correct symptom of eczema
Stated one correct way to prevent eczema
Wrote in clear sentences suitable for a school notice board

hints: Mention moisturising or avoiding harsh soaps.
